note: Accepted drift in SHIPPED artifacts, as stable violation keys. Every entry needs a real reason. The gate fails on NEW drift and on exemptions that are no longer needed, so this list can only shrink without a deliberate, reviewed change.

a-frame-22.reason: TRACED plan (project guardrail: traced artifacts are never edited). Its fixtures record a real source drawing, so a headroom violation here judges that drawing, not our compiler. Recording them keeps the count honest and catches any NEW drift if the trace is ever re-imported.

a-frame-bunk.reason: TRACED plan (project guardrail: never edited). Same as a-frame-22 — the loft kitchenette headroom is what the source drawing shows; our generated-fixture rule does not govern a traced building.

brief-aframe-2br.reason: COMPILED by an older compiler, before envelope-aware fixture placement. NOT regenerated on purpose: recompiling its brief ("2-bed A-frame, <=800 sqft, 40x60 lot") with today's compiler yields a DIFFERENT BUILDING — 28x28 instead of 24x28, 7 rooms instead of 6 — because the template chosen for a <=800 sqft cap has changed. Both fit the brief, so this is not a defect to fix silently; swapping the gallery plan for another building is a content decision, not a geometry repair. The 8 headroom violations are recorded until that decision is made.

It was generated before envelope-aware fixture placement, so it carries exactly the defects those fires fixed. outpost-medium.reason: TRACED plan (project guardrail: never edited). Two overlaps, now DIAGNOSED against the source drawing (chatgpt-handoff/generated/outpost-medium-proposal-paired-v11.png) rather than guessed at. (1) fx-stoop/fx-entry-storage overlap 0.08x0.09 ft, right at the 0.06 ft clearance epsilon — noise. (2) fx-bed10/fx-bedroom10-wardrobe overlap 4.57x1.85 ft is a REAL TRACING ERROR: the source shows the bed head against bedroom 10's north wall and the closet as a VERTICAL run on the east wall, but the artifact records the wardrobe as a horizontal band on the north wall — w=12.4152/d=1.9470, i.e. its width and depth transposed, so its rotation was lost in tracing. Transposing them and seating it against the east wall (x 17.05-19.00) clears the bed completely (x-overlap 0.00). Its 12.4 ft length also exceeds the room's 11 ft depth, so the length is slightly off too. Not repaired here: traced artifacts are never edited, and this one lives in the dev-compiler checkout.
